acip: MA GRUB NA, RTAG PA CHOS CAN, KHYOD DANG GCIG YANG YIN, DNGOS PO YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA MED PAR THAL, RTAG PA DE YIN DGOS LA DE YANG MIN, DE LAS GZHAN PA GCIG MED PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, rtag pa chos can, khyod dang gcig yang yin, dngos po yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa med par thal, rtag pa de yin dgos la de yang min, de las gzhan pa gcig med pa'i phyir
english: I disagree that something which is the same as something which is unchanging is (1) different from a working thing; and (2) that there exists no example of something which is both it, and also a working thing. Suppose you do disagree. In that case, let's take unchanging things. It is so the case that there is nothing which is both one with it, and also a working thing; Because that would have to be an unchanging thing; and there is nothing else that is both not that, and yet different from that.
